quotes.text: Tell me what you eat, and I will tell you what you are.
Eat food. Not too much. Mostly plants.
Take care of your body. It’s the only place you have to live.
One cannot think well, love well, sleep well, if one has not dined well.

quotes.gloss: The first happiness is a healthy body.

quotes.text: जैसा खाओ अन्न, वैसा होवे मन।
quotes.gloss: As is the food you eat, so is the mind.
When the food is pure, the mind grows clear.

quotes.text: When diet is wrong, medicine is of no use. When diet is correct, medicine is of no need.
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
Eat breakfast like a king, lunch like a prince and dinner like a pauper.
Eat only once the last meal has settled, and the body will need no medicine.
Well-being keeps company with those who eat in measure. Illness keeps company with those who eat far beyond it.
